primitivekiln:moddesc: Fire bricks in a covered clamp, like a charcoal mound.
primitivekiln:clamp-fuel: Brick clamp: {0}/{1}s fuel loaded ({2} brick piles). Add fuel, then light with a torch.
primitivekiln:clamp-ready: Brick clamp: fuelled ({0} brick piles). Light with a torch, then cover it in soil.
primitivekiln:clamp-unsealed: Not sealed — cover every exposed side in soil to keep it firing.
primitivekiln:clamp-needfuel: Not enough fuel loaded to fire this clamp.
primitivekiln:clamp-badfuel: That won't fire bricks — use firewood, charcoal, coal, coke or peat.
primitivekiln:clamp-notfull: Every pile in the clamp must hold a full 24 bricks before fuelling.
primitivekiln:clamp-fillfirst: Brick clamp: fill every pile to 24 bricks, then add fuel.
primitivekiln:clamp-full: Brick clamp fuelled: {0}/{1}s — light it with a torch.
primitivekiln:kiln-place-hint: Right-click with fireclay bricks to start building an updraft kiln. Place 4 bases in a square for a large kiln.
primitivekiln:kiln-construct: Updraft kiln: tier {0}/{1} built. Next tier: {2} fireclay bricks (one click).
primitivekiln:kiln-built: The kiln shell is complete — load it with unfired clayware through the door.
primitivekiln:kiln-open: Updraft kiln: door open, {0}/{1} pieces loaded. Seal the door with {2} fireclay bricks (one click).
primitivekiln:kiln-err-needbricks: The next step needs {0} fireclay bricks in hand.
primitivekiln:kiln-err-toobig: That piece is too large to fit in the kiln.
primitivekiln:kiln-sealed-msg: The door is sealed — add fuel, then hold a torch to it.
primitivekiln:kiln-sealed: Updraft kiln: sealed. Fuel: {0}/{1}s. Light with a torch (hold).
primitivekiln:kiln-fueled: The kiln is fuelled: {0}/{1}s — hold a torch to it.
primitivekiln:kiln-cooled: Updraft kiln: cooled. Right-click with an empty hand to open the door.
primitivekiln:kiln-err-buildfirst: Finish building the kiln shell first.
primitivekiln:kiln-err-sealfirst: Seal the door with fireclay bricks before fuelling.
primitivekiln:kiln-err-hot: The kiln is still hot — let it finish firing and cool down.
